abstract: Evaluates environmental impact metrics and emission reductions
system_message:
You are the Sustainability coordinator (SST), responsible for evaluating environmental impact metrics and emission reductions across distributor operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates environmental impact metrics and emission reductions（ECO）
information_points.content:
SST-ECO-IIY：For Apex Cryo Transcontinental, corporate sustainability disclosures indicate a fleet electrification rate of 65 % of total kilometers driven by fully electric vehicles within its urban delivery van fleet across target markets.
SST-ECO-5YT：Vanguard Biopharma Freight maintains a fleet electrification rate of 45 % based on total kilometers driven by fully electric urban delivery vans across target markets, as documented in its corporate sustainability disclosure.
SST-ECO-AUN：According to the corporate sustainability disclosure for Nordic Polar Logistics, the fleet electrification rate across urban delivery vans operated in target markets is 45 % of total kilometers driven by fully electric delivery vehicles.

information_points.title: Reusable packaging quota（PACK）
information_points.content:
SST-PACK-CT8：For Apex Cryo Transcontinental, the packaging reuse ratio stands at 70 % of all outbound secondary shipping containers returned and reconditioned, according to its packaging lifecycle inventory report.
SST-PACK-SCF：The packaging lifecycle inventory report indicates that Nordic Polar Logistics achieves a packaging reuse ratio of 90 % across all outbound secondary shipping containers returned and reconditioned.
SST-PACK-YJ0：Based on its packaging lifecycle inventory report, Vanguard Biopharma Freight demonstrates a packaging reuse ratio of 50 % for all outbound secondary shipping containers returned and reconditioned.
